resources.string: Use OTTPlay as this device’s Home app to open the player at startup. The Home button will also open OTTPlay. Keep the original launcher installed. This screen does not change playlists or playback settings.
OTTPlay is selected as the Home app. Verify startup after restarting this device.
OTTPlay Home entry is enabled. It is not confirmed as the selected Home app.
This firmware could not complete the operation. Check the system Home app settings.

Enable OTTPlay as a Home app option? Android will ask you to select the Home app. If you cancel that selection, the OTTPlay option remains enabled, but your selected Home app is not changed by this screen.
First select another Home app in system settings. Then return here and press Disable again. If no other Home app is confirmed, the OTTPlay entry stays enabled.
Another Home app is selected. Remove OTTPlay from the Home app options? The normal OTTPlay app and its saved profiles will remain available.
